keval 1 din men
Hastmethun karna sharir ke kul milakar hanikarak hota hai!
Running men Stamina kam hota hai.
Vitamin e ki kami ho jati hai ,jisse aap Indian Army Eye's medical Test se bahar ho sakte hai.
Hastamaithun karne se ghutnen ka painchalu ho jata hai,jisse aap Running men 100 nahi de sakte hai , running men fail ho sakte ho!
Doston men dave ke sath bol raha hun,hastamaithun karna hamare sharir ke bahut hi hanikarak hai.
Aap ise bilkul bhi nahin karen,kabhi aapko bhartiy sena ka javan banna hai to!
